top: Whoever designed this Christmas book cover forgot how mirrors work
comment: A real mirror would flip every letter, so “LEON” shouldn't even be readable. Still a great title for the sequel 🎄
topic_it: Copertina del libro di Natale 'The First Leon': il bambino con la maglia NOEL allo specchio diventa LEON (gli specchi non funzionano così)
photo_it: Foto della copertina (Reddit r/CrappyDesign, via Bored Panda)
sound: All I Want for Christmas Is You — Mariah Carey
title: How did this book cover pass design? #designfail #christmas #funny
description:
On this Christmas book cover, NOEL in the mirror somehow reads LEON, perfectly. Photo via r/CrappyDesign.
